# HotelRateIntel (Hotel Rate Intelligence)

> Made by Hoteliers with 20 years in luxury hospitality and powered by AI: multi-OTA rate parity monitoring, Suite-vs-Suite equivalency comparison, OOO/OOS Reservations Ops AI auto-pricing, and overnight courtesy call-around desk for independent boutique hotels. Built in Miami Beach by AI Dynamic Pro.

- **Website:** https://hotelrateintel.com/
- **Creator:** AI Dynamic Pro (https://www.aidynamic.pro) — Founded by Jasmel Acosta
- **Contact:** jasmel@hotelrateintel.com | +1 (786) 970-8366
- **Primary Market:** Miami Beach boutique hotels (15–75 rooms; portable to any hospitality micro-market)

## Core Capabilities
1. **Live Multi-OTA Rate Ladder & Bedbank Shield:** Compares Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia, Trip.com, and Vio.com against each hotel's official Direct BAR at 6:00 AM EST daily.
2. **Exact Room Equivalency Comparator:** Matches Suite vs. Suite, Double vs. Double, and Single Occupancy while normalizing rollaway beds, resort fees, 14% tax, and housekeeping cadence.
3. **Live Room Ops (OOO / OOS / HK Hold) & AI Auto-Pricing:** Tracks Out-of-Order, Out-of-Service, and Housekeeping holds to recalculate true net sellable occupancy, apply guardrailed floor/ceiling BAR + CTA/Min-LOS rules, and dispatch Telegram shift alerts.
4. **Overnight Night Audit Courtesy Call-Around & Competitor Inquiry Desk:** Pre-Audit (11:30 PM–1:15 AM) and Post-Audit (3:30 AM–4:45 AM) scripts plus competitor group/corporate inquiry tracking.
5. **Booking Engine & PMS Compatibility:** Ready-to-load payloads for Opera, SynXis/Sabre, Cloudbeds, Mews, Channex, and TravelClick.
6. **Typical 45-Room Boutique Benchmark Impact:** +$3,400/mo direct booking & ADR recovery + $1,125/mo (45 hrs) staff time freed = +$4,525/mo (+$54,300/yr).

## Transparent Month-to-Month Pricing Tiers (No Annual Lock-In)
- **Free Starter:** $0/month forever (3 comp-set properties, live parity checks)
- **Boutique Core:** $99/month ($49 Month 1 intro · 10 comp-set properties, 6:00 AM EST briefs, Suite-vs-Suite matching, OOO/OOS Room Ops)
- **Pro Revenue & Call Desk:** $199/month (20 comp-set properties, Overnight Courtesy Call-Around Desk, AI Auto-Pricing rules, instant SMS/WhatsApp alerts)
- **Multi-Property Group:** $399/month (Up to 5 boutique properties under unified cluster oversight)
